title: C++ Lab
subtitle: A hands-on C++ course: read, predict, run, test.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.blurb: From your first line of code to your first small program.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.blurb: Collections, your own types, and programs that span files.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.blurb: Ownership, errors, templates and the tools real projects need.

levels.name: Expert Track
levels.blurb: C++20 features, threads, measurement and a tested capstone.

lessons.title: Your first program
lessons.goal: Write, compile and run the smallest complete C++ program.

lessons.title: Printing several things
lessons.goal: Combine text and numbers in one print, and choose between \n and endl.

lessons.title: Variables hold values
lessons.goal: Store a value in a named box and change it later.

lessons.title: Types: int, double, char, bool
lessons.goal: Pick the right type for each kind of value and know what each one prints.

lessons.title: Reading what the user types
lessons.goal: Ask a question, read the answer, and use it.

lessons.title: Arithmetic and the integer trap
lessons.goal: Calculate with + - * / % and avoid the integer division surprise.

lessons.title: Making decisions with if
lessons.goal: Run different code depending on a condition.

lessons.title: Several choices and combining conditions
lessons.goal: Choose between many outcomes and join conditions with && and ||.

lessons.title: Repeating with while
lessons.goal: Repeat work until a condition becomes false.

lessons.title: Counting with for
lessons.goal: Use a for loop for a known number of repeats.

lessons.title: Functions: giving code a name
lessons.goal: Move repeated code into a function and call it by name.

lessons.title: Functions that return values
lessons.goal: Pass information in and get an answer back.

lessons.title: Working with text
lessons.goal: Join, measure and pick apart std::string values.

lessons.title: Project: score tracker
lessons.goal: Combine variables, loops, conditions and functions into one small working program.

lessons.title: Arrays: many values, one name
lessons.goal: Store a row of values and walk through them with a loop.

lessons.title: Vectors: the array that grows
lessons.goal: Use std::vector when you do not know the size in advance.

lessons.title: References: another name for the same box
lessons.goal: Change the caller's variable from inside a function.

lessons.title: Pointers: the address of a value
lessons.goal: Read a pointer, follow it, and know what nullptr means.

lessons.title: Structs: grouping facts together
lessons.goal: Bundle related values into one type of your own.

lessons.title: Classes: data plus behaviour
lessons.goal: Attach functions to your type and guarantee it starts in a valid state.

lessons.title: Encapsulation: protecting the rules
lessons.goal: Keep an object's rules true by refusing bad changes.

lessons.title: map and set: looking things up
lessons.goal: Store values by key and keep a collection of unique items.

lessons.title: The algorithm library
lessons.goal: Replace hand-written loops with tested standard algorithms.

lessons.title: Reading and writing files
lessons.goal: Save data between runs and read it back.

lessons.title: Declarations, definitions, and many files
lessons.goal: Understand what goes in a header and why programs are split up.

lessons.title: Project: robot fleet board
lessons.goal: Combine structs, vectors and algorithms into a small report generator.

lessons.title: Scope and object lifetime
lessons.goal: Know exactly when an object is created and when it dies.

lessons.title: The heap, new and delete
lessons.goal: Create objects whose lifetime you control, and clean them up correctly.

lessons.title: RAII: let the destructor clean up
lessons.goal: Tie a resource's lifetime to an object so it can never be forgotten.

lessons.title: unique_ptr: one clear owner
lessons.goal: Use heap objects without writing delete anywhere.

lessons.title: shared_ptr and weak_ptr
lessons.goal: Share ownership between several places without deciding who deletes.

lessons.title: Exceptions: reporting the impossible
lessons.goal: Signal failure up the call stack without returning error codes everywhere.

lessons.title: std::optional and honest returns
lessons.goal: Return 'a value or nothing' without magic numbers.

lessons.title: Function templates
lessons.goal: Write one function that works for many types.

lessons.title: Class templates
lessons.goal: Build a container type that can hold anything.

lessons.title: Lambdas and captures
lessons.goal: Write small functions where they are used, and control what they can see.

lessons.title: Move semantics
lessons.goal: Understand what std::move actually does and when it saves work.

lessons.title: Project: inventory with tests
lessons.goal: Build a small class with rules, then prove the rules hold with tests.

lessons.title: Concepts: templates that explain themselves
lessons.goal: Constrain a template so bad types fail with a readable error.

lessons.title: Ranges and views
lessons.goal: Filter and transform a collection without writing loops or copies.

lessons.title: Threads and mutexes
lessons.goal: Run work in parallel without corrupting shared data.

lessons.title: async and future
lessons.goal: Start work now and collect the result when you need it.

lessons.title: Measuring performance
lessons.goal: Measure how long code takes, and avoid believing a single run.

lessons.title: Project organisation and build checks
lessons.goal: Make the build fail loudly when the standard or feature is wrong.

lessons.title: Capstone 1: designing the classes
lessons.goal: Turn a fuzzy requirement into classes with clear responsibilities.

lessons.title: Capstone 2: a test harness and the finish
lessons.goal: Wire the planner into a tiny test harness so the rules stay true.
